description: Obs-meta trace completeness (PR #1111 plus the first-tick freshness follow-on). Four panels surface the schedd gauge `schedd_operator_action_trace_completeness_ratio{kind}` and the producer-written `schedd_operator_action_trace_completeness_last_success_timestamp_seconds`. The explicit `schedd_operator_action_trace_completeness_first_tick_completed_total` counter distinguishes cold start from a broken driver. CRITICAL: every query filters on `schedd_…` because the gauge is registered on every daemon but only schedd's driver calls Set. Companion alerts: FaasOperatorActionTraceCompletenessLowPage, FaasOperatorActionTraceCompletenessLowWarn, FaasOperatorActionTraceCompletenessLoopStalled, and FaasOperatorActionTraceCompletenessFirstTickStalled. Runbook: docs/runbooks/FaasOperatorActionTraceCompletenessLow.md. Worst-kind stat panel (id 4) consumes the recording rule `obs:operator_action_trace_completeness_ratio`.

panels.title: Operator action trace completeness by kind (5m)
panels.description: Per-kind ratio time series. clamp_min(0.001) protects the y-axis from the WithLabelValues zero default before the driver's first pass. The vacuous-truth default (=1.0 for absent kinds) means a kind without traffic reads 1.0 here — Panel 2 (audit write rate) is the disambiguator (same precedent as FaasAuditRetentionTableGrowingFasterThanPruned's `volume_rate > 0` precondition at faas.rules.yml:463-469). Threshold bands: green >= 0.95, yellow 0.50-0.95, red < 0.50.

panels.title: Operator action audit write rate by kind (denominator)
panels.description: Stacked topk(8) of audit-write successes across the closed verb-oriented kinds. Counterpart to Panel 1 — a kind whose gauge sits at 1.0 with non-zero write rate is a real completeness violation; a kind whose gauge sits at 1.0 with flat write rate is a vacuous-truth default.

panels.title: Driver loop freshness (s, healthy <180)
panels.description: time() - schedd_operator_action_trace_completeness_last_success_timestamp_seconds. The producer writes this timestamp only after a successful completeness query, so scrape freshness cannot mask a wedged driver. Green < 180s (3x the 60s tick), yellow 180-360s, red >= 360s. Companion alert: FaasOperatorActionTraceCompletenessLoopStalled (info-tier).

panels.title: Worst-kind completeness ratio
panels.description: min(schedd_…) across all kinds — the recording rule `obs:operator_action_trace_completeness_ratio` shipped alongside the alerts. Threshold bands: green >= 0.95, yellow 0.50-0.95, red < 0.50. Same thresholds as FaasOperatorActionTraceCompletenessLowPage / LowWarn.
